title: The lane session installs the pinned Chromium once per session, so lane lint runs the guard suite's browser deny cases
why: Lane lint now runs hooks/test_guard.py with no browser download (decision playwright-install-once: one Playwright install, never from an agent). When the pinned Chromium (playwright 1.64.1, build 1248) cannot launch, the page-item-design deny cases are skipped; debt lane-lint-guard-browser-skip records that.
note: Topic lane-lint. A follow-up PR with Merge after: this lane's lane-lint-guard-suite-install PR (which merges after #1916). The lane session does the install, never an agent. A cloud box lasts one session, so once per box means once per session. The record says how a session finds the browser already installed.
